title: G2b: repo map generator — orchestrator repomap writes memory/architecture.md (module, public symbols, one-line purpose, commit sha) under about 1,000 tokens, refreshed after every merge
spec:
memory/architecture.md is empty (the record.sh set architecture path exists but nothing generates content). The analysis asks for an aider-style repo map: selected symbols and signatures within a token budget, versioned against repository state, retrieved by workers instead of rediscovered.
Change:
1. New orchestrator/repomap.py: build(root, budget_chars=4000) parses every orchestrator/*.py with ast, takes the module docstring's first sentence, top-level classes and functions with their signatures (name and parameter names, no bodies), ranks modules by how many other modules import them (simple import graph) and trims the lowest-ranked symbols first until the budget fits; output is markdown: a header line 'repo map <sha> <date>' then one section per module with the symbol list; deterministic ordering.
2. cli.py: `orchestrator repomap [--budget N] [--stdout]` writes .orchestrator/memory/architecture.md (or prints).
3. merge.py: after a successful fast-forward, regenerate architecture.md in the ORCH_ROOT checkout only when the merged diff touched orchestrator/*.py (cheap check via git diff --name-only), never failing the merge if generation raises (log to stderr).
4. Tests in tests/test_repomap.py: test_build_fits_budget (a fixture package with three modules, one importing the other two, budget forces trimming and keeps the most-imported module), test_build_deterministic, test_header_has_sha; tests/test_merge.py::test_merge_refreshes_repomap_on_py_change (monkeypatched build called once).
Note: do not let the generator import the modules; ast only.
acceptance: uv run orchestrator repomap --stdout on this repo prints under 4,000 characters and lists daemon.py, bus.py and spawn.py with their public functions
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

result.summary: Codex committed dd8ab79 in wt/T-0267 (second thread 01a0bb30-91c5-7660-9249-1d94801079cd after the first ended without committing): orchestrator/repomap.py (ast-only, import-graph ranked, budgeted, deterministic, header with sha), `orchestrator repomap [--budget N] [--stdout]`, merge-time refresh of memory/architecture.md when the merged diff touched orchestrator/*.py. Root cause of the suite hang the first thread hit: test_merge's real-repo merges launched full gates in fresh worktrees based on the prior HEAD and re-ran test_merge recursively; fix: merge passes an inherited ORCH_TESTS_GREEN marker into its gate, merges under that marker skip another gate and the repo-map refresh, and the refresh requires a real orchestrator/repomap.py under ORCH_ROOT and skips dry runs. repomap --stdout prints 3,808 chars naming bus.py, daemon.py and spawn.py. tests-green.sh wt/T-0267 exited 0 in 50 s (Planner). Posted by hand.
